fato_historico: 1917: Old Style date of the October Revolution in Russia.
energia_do_dia: Today brings a transformative shift, much like a sudden change in the tides of history. It is a good time to consider how your inner revolutions shape your cozy home life. Perhaps you may find that letting go of old structures creates room for new, vibrant growth. Embrace the subtle currents of change and allow your heart to lead the way forward.
frase_do_dia: The greatest revolutions begin within the quiet spaces of your own soul.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of deep wisdom through emotional intelligence and grace.
conselho: Trust your intuition and nurture your creative spirit with gentle, consistent care.
